Senses.Explanation: A household thief is hard to guard against because the threat already occupies the defended house. Liangshan Yuanguan answers that recognition ends the grievance; Nanyan Sheng reuses the line directly, while Zhe’an Jingfan and Dabei Miaoyun criticize or replace Liangshan’s handling. Complete-unit reading distinguishes original utterance, later raising, verse/commentary, biography, and paratext, and controls duplicate recensions at the deployment-family level.
